page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a marginal note at the right beside the line "se-", and a faint note fragment at the far right edge. Page number at the top right.

p.i: ditionemque sui, qua sese diabolo principi mortis & peecato manci-pauit, animum bona refugientem inde à lapsu ipsius, luxuriantem malis, & Deo, sibi, omnique bono (quod quidem vere bonū est) per se aduersantem, vt in bono falso & opinabili defixus hæreat. Ostende-rem, qui tandem euentus ex ista peruersitate maneat Adami filios aberrantes à vero, & falsis opinio-nibus suis incumbentes: malis male futurū esse: & prout veritatem in iniustitia detinent, ita Deum se-Rom. 1. 18uerissima in ipsos iudicia exercitu-rum veritate sua, vt quàm longis-simè à Deo discesserunt, sic ab eis penitus discessuru Deum, cùmque gratia illius cœlestis præmia amplis-sima

page.notes: The right margin note "Rom. 1. 18" is printed beside the line "se-". A partly cut-off marginal fragment appears at the far right edge. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is present and has been omitted. The catchword "sima" is shown at the foot of the last line as printed.
